Bug_Title: Consumed Stream pipelines should not be reused
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where the same stream pipeline is used after a terminal operation, which is not allowed according to the Stream API.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when we try to reuse a stream pipeline after a terminal operation has been performed. This is demonstrated in the test case where we attempt to use the stream pipeline a second time to calculate sum2, which results in an IllegalStateException because the stream has already been consumed.
